beats.text: Lead admits: I might have a small plant problem.
Camera pulls back to reveal an apartment overflowing with plants.
Lead squeezes between the plants: There’s still room.

shots.prompt: Use <Picture 1> as exact first frame and identity reference. One continuous 10-second shot in a tactile premium 3D animated comedy, restrained natural daylight and true-to-life color, no oversaturated orange filter. {Lead} holds a tiny terracotta plant in an apartment doorway. 0–3 seconds: looks innocently at camera, slightly guilty smile, speaks exactly: "I might have a small plant problem." 3–7 seconds: camera smoothly dollies backward and slightly sideways through the open doorway to reveal the full living room as a hilariously dense indoor jungle: plants cover the sofa and dining table, pots line the floor, hanging vines and huge leafy plants nearly block the hall. Plants are stationary objects being revealed by camera movement, never magically appearing. Keep Lead visible as the shot widens. 7–10 seconds: Lead carefully sidesteps between pots, hugging the tiny plant protectively, pauses to assess one absurdly small empty spot, then looks at camera and says exactly: "There's still room." Hold a quietly proud deadpan smile. Clear adult conversational speech, not a child voice. Only Lead speaks. Quiet room ambience and gentle leaf rustle/footsteps; NO music, narrator, other voices, extra dialogue, captions, text or logos. Keep identity, hands, glasses and pot stable. Lip movements match the two spoken lines. No cuts.
